author: J. C. Kemp
title: All 5th-graders at Mabel-Canton Elementary School participated in 2024-25 MCA math assessment
text:
The fifth-grade class at Mabel-Canton Elementary School recorded full participation in the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA, the Minnesota Department of Education reports.
The group included 22 fifth-grade students out of 86 total test-takers at Mabel-Canton Elementary School who completed the math portion.
Test results show that 50% of fifth-graders demonstrated proficiency in mathematics based on established benchmarks.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) serve as state evaluations to gauge students’ progress toward Minnesota’s academic standards and fulfill federal and state regulations. These tests assess math, reading, and science, varying by grade level. The MCA is administered to most students, while eligible students receiving special education services may take the Alt MCA.
Overall proficiency on Minnesota’s MCA exams has declined compared to pre-pandemic levels , according to Minnesota’s Report Card. Math proficiency has decreased more than 7% from 2019, while reading rates have dropped nearly 5%.
